status: exploratory protocol frozen before model fitting and final-label evaluation
ordering: Published row order, conditional chronology; normalized dates are inconsistent. No sorting or invented calendar timestamps.
preprocessing: Train-only StandardScaler; no imputation by us. Released data already globally normalized and missing-value filtered, which cannot be reversed. No target lag. Exclude current price/demand/transfer/date.
diagnostics: Covariate score=max absolute difference of window and development standardized feature means. Confidence score=absolute window mean error probability minus development mean. Normalize each by its development-window 80th percentile (floor 1e-12). Combined=max of normalized scores. Threshold each policy at its calibration-window 80th percentile; alert strictly above. Labels never enter alert scores.
hypothesis: Combined applicability/confidence warnings improve degraded-window recall relative to covariate-only warnings at matched calibration alert budgets without increasing test false alarms. Improvement is exploratory; no prospective power claim.
degraded_window: Retrospective accepted error risk exceeds model calibration accepted risk by more than 0.05; missing risk is unknown, never safe.
gate: Withhold all otherwise accepted predictions in alerted window. End-of-window batch decision before labels, not a real-time early warning.
uncertainty: 1000 paired circular moving-block bootstrap replicates of ordered day units; block lengths 1,7,14 days, primary 7. Frozen models/thresholds. Percentile linear interpolation. Missing labels, zero/all events, less than 2 blocks or any undefined replicate produce null risk interval. No independent-day or stationarity guarantee. Paired masks share resampled rows.
multiplicity: One exploratory primary recall/false-alarm comparison per model; no p-values or superiority declaration. All other outcomes/ablations descriptive, no selection of favorable windows or block length.
precision: For independent Bernoulli units worst-case 95% half-width .05 needs ceil(1.96^2*.25/.05^2)=385; these dependent windows cannot establish that precision. Prospective repeated independent streams and paired power analysis required.
